title: A server executor clones any url a job names and runs that repository's tools with the placed identity
goal: Home takes the urls a server executor serves (kj_exec.Home(base, allowed): the repeatable serve option --remote URL, compared after kj_store's credential-free form) and its prepare refuses a job whose remote is not among them, as an Unprepared naming the url, before any git call; the file transport is not in GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL for a server executor

run: import sys,inspect; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import kj_exec; assert 'allowed' in inspect.signature(kj_exec.Home).parameters

repro_reason: the clone of an arbitrary url needs a served queue; the repro asks for the allowlist parameter and the fix carries a planted-url check

gates.question: How does a server executor started with no --remote url, or a --remote on another kind, behave?
options: serve exits 2 at start (kbjob.py parser error)
serve starts and refuses every job as Unprepared
gates.recommendation: serve exits 2 at start (kbjob.py parser error)
gates.reason: a server that can serve no url fails where the operator sees it, not in each job
gates.answer: serve exits 2 at start (kbjob.py parser error)

gates.question: How is a job's remote url compared with the urls a server serves?
options: exactly, after the credential-free form of both (kj_store.bare_url)
also ignoring a trailing slash and a .git suffix
gates.recommendation: exactly, after the credential-free form of both (kj_store.bare_url)
gates.reason: the job record and the dir_of clone name already use that form, and a looser match would serve a url the operator did not name
gates.answer: exactly, after the credential-free form of both (kj_store.bare_url)

gates.question: Is Home's allowed parameter required or does it default to no urls?
options: required: a Home built without the urls fails at once
optional, defaulting to none, so every job is refused
gates.recommendation: required: a Home built without the urls fails at once
gates.reason: so no caller can forget the list
gates.answer: required: a Home built without the urls fails at once

run: import sys,inspect; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import kj_exec; assert 'allowed' in inspect.signature(kj_exec.Home).parameters
